rites.name: Siluamanae
rites.text: Siluamanae is the resonant thread that the Singing draws through unformed matter, a concept that binds root-stuff into the first shapes of Seraurnanum. During the Age of Sundering it is said to be the note that split the old bonds when landfall came, each fracture carrying the echo of its tone.

rites.name: Reornenus
rites.text: Reornenus is the concept of the reckoning that binds oaths to the doors between the worlds of Seraurnanum, so that no promise made in one realm can be broken in another. It was first set down by the sovereign's council during the early groves, when the kingdoms were still growing and the trials of the gods were not yet closed.

rites.name: Seiziasora
rites.text: Seiziasora is a concept in the Seraurnanum omniverse, born in the Seeding when the makers plant the Weave and quiet powers sleep, and it takes its shape during the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke old bonds between peoples. It is remembered as the idea that a sleeping power can be woken by a single word of loss.

rites.name: Surakaari
rites.text: Surakaari is the concept of the Sustaining Flame, the vow that kept shattered worlds from going cold during the Sundering and the Shards. In the Holy Age its temples taught that every ember carries a promise, and its orders bound themselves to guard those promises.

rites.name: Oriamwen
rites.text: Oriamwen is the concept of the Fall in Seraurnanum, the moment the Sundering broke worlds into Shards and the Pact was sworn among the survivors. In the Age of Sundering, landfall on the broken ground dissolved the old bonds between peoples and their homelands. It is remembered as both the wound and the vow that followed it.
